features.title: Stock Monitoring and Adjustment
features.description: Enables stock operators to view paginated stock records in a ListView, navigate pages, sort by column, search by product code/description/main product, open adjustment form on double-click, print stock information report, and refresh data.

functions.label: Load and paginate stock monitoring view (Form_Load)
functions.description: When the stock monitoring form opens, it connects to the database, retrieves all stock records sorted by main product, and displays them in a list with 75 records per page. This provides operators with immediate access to stock data in a manageable, paginated layout.

functions.label: Show selected record identifier on click (lvList_Click)
functions.description: When the user clicks an item in the stock list, the system updates a status label to show that record’s identifier. This gives the operator a quick view of which stock entry is currently selected.

functions.label: Open stock adjustment form via double-click (lvList_DblClick)
functions.description: Double-clicking a stock row verifies the record exists and then opens a modal update form where the user can adjust stock details. This provides a direct way to modify stock information from the monitoring list.

functions.label: Sort stock list by column header click (lvList_ColumnClick)
functions.description: The operator can click any column header to sort the stock list by that attribute; clicking the same column again reverses the sort order. This allows quick on-client reordering without reloading data from the server.

functions.label: Update selected record label via keyboard navigation (lvList_KeyUp)
functions.description: When the user navigates the list using arrow or page keys, the system updates the status label to reflect the currently highlighted record. This ensures keyboard-friendly operation and keeps the user informed of which item is selected.

functions.label: Show record actions context menu on right-click (lvList_MouseUp)
functions.description: Right-clicking a stock list item displays a pop-up menu containing available actions such as adjusting the record or searching. This gives operators convenient access to common tasks directly from the list.

functions.label: Adapt form layout on window resize (Form_Resize)
functions.description: When the user resizes the stock monitoring window, the system automatically adjusts the list and bar to fill the available space, enforcing a minimum size. This ensures a usable and responsive interface regardless of window dimensions.

functions.label: Clean up and refresh on form close (Form_Unload)
functions.description: When the operator closes the stock monitoring window, the system removes it from the parent application's window list, hides the corresponding toolbar button, and destroys the form. If a refresh was requested by an update form, the latest stock data is reloaded before final cleanup.

functions.label: Filter stock records by search condition (FilterRecord)
functions.description: An external search form passes a filter condition to the stock monitoring view, which updates the underlying query and reloads the displayed records. This enables operators to narrow down the stock list to entries matching specific criteria.

functions.label: Refresh stock data from database (CommandPass("Refresh"))
functions.description: The operator triggers a data refresh, causing the system to re-query the database using the original saved SQL and re-apply pagination. This ensures the displayed stock records are up-to-date after changes elsewhere.

functions.label: Print stock information report (CommandPass("Print"))
functions.description: The operator can print a detailed stock information report; the system generates a data source, configures the Crystal report with current business address details, and displays the report for printing. This provides a physical record of stock status for distribution or filing.

results.module_business_description: Manages the receipt, inspection, and monitoring of inventory stock, supporting operational printing and real-time viewing for warehouse personnel.

features.title: Stock Receive Listing and Record Operations
features.description: Enables warehouse operators to view stock receive records in a paged list, navigate between pages, sort by column, open records for editing, add new stock receive entries, delete with inventory adjustment, search via multi-column filters, print records, and refresh the list.

functions.label: Load and paginate stock receive records (Form_Load)
functions.description: When the form opens, it retrieves all stock receive records from the database and displays the first 75 records in a list, with paging controls ready for navigation. This initial view gives warehouse operators immediate access to the most recent stock receives.

functions.label: Sort stock receive list by column (lvList_ColumnClick)
functions.description: Clicking a column header sorts the displayed stock receive records in ascending or descending order based on that column's values. The sorting happens instantly on the loaded page, helping operators quickly organise records by date, reference, or other data points.

functions.label: Open selected stock receive for editing (lvList_DblClick)
functions.description: Double-clicking a record in the list opens a detailed edit form preloaded with that stock receive's data, enabling the operator to modify it. If the record has been removed in the meantime, a warning appears and the list refreshes to reflect the current state.

functions.label: Show selected record number (lvList_Click)
functions.description: When a user clicks on a row in the list, a label updates to display the sequence number of that record on the current page. This provides a quick reference to which item is selected for subsequent actions.

functions.label: Update selection via keyboard navigation (lvList_KeyUp)
functions.description: Using arrow keys or Page Up/Down to move through the list updates the currently highlighted record and its displayed sequence number. This allows operators who prefer keyboard shortcuts to track the selected record efficiently.

functions.label: Display record context menu on right-click (lvList_MouseUp)
functions.description: Right-clicking on a record in the list opens a context menu with available actions for that stock receive (such as edit, delete, or print). This gives the operator a quick, contextual way to access common record operations.

functions.label: Add a new stock receive record (CommandPass "New")
functions.description: The 'New' command opens a blank entry form in add mode, allowing the operator to create a fresh stock receive. After filling in the details and saving, the record becomes part of the inventory receiving history.

functions.label: Delete stock receive and adjust inventory (CommandPass "Delete")
functions.description: The delete action prompts the operator for confirmation, then removes the selected stock receive record while also reversing its impact on inventory quantities. This ensures stock levels are correctly updated after a deletion, maintaining accurate inventory counts.

functions.label: Search stock receive records by column (CommandPass "Search")
functions.description: The search function opens a dialog where the operator can filter records by entering keywords or criteria against four specific columns (such as reference number, date, supplier, etc.). Once applied, the list shows only matching stock receives, helping users quickly locate records of interest.

functions.label: Refresh stock receive list and clear filters (CommandPass "Refresh")
functions.description: The refresh command re-queries the database and reloads the list with the latest stock receive data, removing any active search filters. This ensures operators are viewing the most current records, especially after other users may have added or modified records.

functions.label: Print stock receive records (CommandPass "Print")
functions.description: The print action opens a print options dialog specific to stock receives, allowing the operator to configure and print a hard copy of the list or detailed records. This supports physical documentation requirements and warehouse record-keeping.

functions.label: Adapt list view to window size (Form_Resize)
functions.description: When the operator resizes the window, the stock receive list and its title area automatically expand or shrink to fill the available space. This ensures the list remains fully visible and usable regardless of the window dimensions.

functions.label: Close the stock receive listing (Form_Unload)
functions.description: When the operator closes the stock receive listing window, it removes itself from the application's internal window list, hides any associated toolbar button, and cleans up resources. If necessary, it also refreshes the parent window to reflect any changes.

functions.label: Jump to first page of records (btnFirst_Click)
functions.description: The 'First' button immediately loads page 1 of the stock receive list, taking the operator back to the beginning of the dataset. This is disabled if they are already viewing the first page.

functions.label: Move to previous page (btnPrev_Click)
functions.description: The 'Previous' button loads the page immediately before the current one, enabling backward navigation through the stock receive records. It is only active when the operator is not on the first page.

functions.label: Move to next page (btnNext_Click)
functions.description: The 'Next' button loads the next set of 75 records, advancing the operator forward through the list. This button is disabled when the last page is reached.

functions.label: Jump to last page of records (btnLast_Click)
functions.description: The 'Last' button takes the operator directly to the final page of stock receive records, showing the most recent entries. It is available only if the user is not already on the last page.

functions.label: Close the stock receive window (CommandPass "Close")
functions.description: The close command unloads the stock receive listing form, returning to the parent window. This provides an alternative way to exit the screen, such as from a toolbar button or menu.

features.title: Stock Inventory Viewer with Search and Pagination
features.description: Enables warehouse operators to view inventory stock items with search, filter, paginated browsing (75 rows per page), client-side column sorting, and row-level detail inspection.

functions.label: Display the initial stock inventory list (Form_Load)
functions.description: When the Stock Viewer opens, the system retrieves all stock records sorted by Main Product and Product Code, displays them in a paginated list with 75 items per page, and sets up icons and images for the interface. This provides the warehouse operator with an immediate overview of all available inventory items.

functions.label: Open search filter for stock items (Command2_Click)
functions.description: When the operator activates Search, a modal search form opens with predefined columns and a “Main Product” filter option. After the operator defines the filter and confirms, the stock list is reloaded to show only matching records, allowing quick location of specific inventory items.

functions.label: Reset stock list to full inventory (Command3_Click)
functions.description: Triggered by the Refresh command, the system restores the original unfiltered query, clears any active search criteria, and reloads the first page of results. This ensures the operator can always return to a complete view of all stock items without manually clearing filters.

functions.label: View details for selected stock item (lvList_Click)
functions.description: When the operator clicks on a stock item in the list, the system extracts the item’s identifier and updates the record detail area to show the currently selected item’s information. This gives the operator immediate context about the highlighted stock entry without leaving the list view.

functions.label: Sort current stock list by column (lvList_ColumnClick)
functions.description: Clicking a column header toggles the sort order for that column on the currently loaded page of stock items. This enables the warehouse operator to reorder the visible records alphabetically or numerically to better analyse the displayed data, though it does not re-fetch data from the server.

functions.label: Update record detail during keyboard navigation (lvList_KeyUp)
functions.description: While navigating the stock list using keyboard arrow keys or Page Up/Down, the system updates the detail section to reflect the currently focused item. This provides continuous feedback to the operator as they move through the list without needing to click.

functions.label: Show context menu for selected stock item (lvList_MouseUp)
functions.description: Right-clicking on a stock item in the list opens a popup menu defined in the main application. This menu provides additional actions that can be performed on the selected item, such as editing or viewing more details, though the specific menu options are not detailed here.

functions.label: Adjust bar width when window is resized (Form_Resize)
functions.description: When the operator resizes the Stock Viewer window, the decorative bar automatically stretches to fit the new width. This maintains a consistent visual layout as the user adjusts the form dimensions, with errors suppressed to prevent runtime interruptions.

functions.label: Release form instance on window close (Form_Unload)
functions.description: Upon closing the Stock Viewer, the system clears the global reference to the form instance to prevent reuse and free memory. This is a housekeeping step that ensures a clean state for future form openings.

functions.label: Close the stock inventory viewer (Command1_Click)
functions.description: The operator can close the Stock Viewer using the Close command, which passes a close signal and unloads the form. This terminates the current inventory viewing session and returns the user to the previous screen.

functions.label: Navigate to the first stock list page (btnFirst_Click)
functions.description: Clicking the First Page button immediately moves the view to the initial set of 75 stock records, provided the operator is not already on the first page. This allows quick access to the beginning of the inventory list.

functions.label: Move to the previous stock list page (btnPrev_Click)
functions.description: The Previous Page button loads the preceding set of records if the operator is not on the first page. This enables backward browsing through the paginated stock items.

functions.label: Move to the next stock list page (btnNext_Click)
functions.description: The Next Page button advances the display to the following batch of 75 records, unless the operator is already viewing the last page. This allows forward progression through the inventory.

functions.label: Navigate to the last stock list page (btnLast_Click)
functions.description: Clicking the Last Page button jumps directly to the final page of stock records, skipping to the end of the list if not already on that page. This gives the operator fast access to the tail end of the inventory data.

user_stories.technical_notes: Legacy form frmStockViewer: Form_Load (EVENT-001) opens ADODB.Recordset rsStocks against global CN connection, uses clsPaging for 75-row pages and pageFillListView to populate ListView lvList. Pagination buttons (btnFirst/btnPrev/btnNext/btnLast) use clsPaging methods. Column sorting is client-side via lvList_ColumnClick. Row selection triggers lvList_Click to update lblCurrentRecord via RightSplitUF. Close button calls Unload Me. Keyboard navigation in lvList_KeyUp refreshes label. Form_Resize adjusts shpBar width.

Use AG Grid with server-side sorting and virtual scrolling. Show selected record details in a side panel updated on row click/select. Pagination controls at bottom. Close navigates back to previous route.

user_stories.technical_notes: Legacy frmStockViewer: Command2_Click (EVENT-002) opens frmSearch modal; on return FilterRecord injects user-supplied srcCondition into SQLParser.wCondition, then ReloadRecords runs rsStocks.Open with dynamic SQL – risk of SQL injection. Command3_Click (EVENT-003) calls RefreshRecords → SQLParser.RestoreStatement → ReloadRecords to reset filter. Error handler catches ADO error -2147217900 and displays 'Invalid search operation.', then restores original SQL.
user_stories.migration_hint: Replace with search dialog component in React. Use GET /api/v1/stock-items/search?q={searchText}&page=1 with parameterised query on ProductCode and Description columns. Provide a 'Reset Filter' button that calls the unfiltered endpoint. All SQL must be generated via an ORM with safe query building.
